title: Simple and clean
body: I love how simple and clean this app is. No ads and free. And no complicated feature. Just simply name your habit and determine the measure. Good to declutter my tasks/habits as well

title: Well Designed, Free, No Clutter.
body:
It’s easy to use. It’s free, no ads. The dev is doing god’s work at this point.

The app oozes quality. Easy to use, works well, well designed. High quality. No clutter.

What else is there to say? It’s top notch.
